purpose: Separate pre-registration for DYNAMIC chunking and HCA. This is a design record, not a runnable confirmation: the fixed-chunk v5 study will consume the WikiText-103 test slice; a second study on the same rows is not independent. Freeze this plan only after a disjoint test corpus (or a disjoint, never-read document split) is reserved.
training_recipe: Same 3000-step/512/12 recipe as v5, but the dynamic arms add the boundary policy knobs (target_block_tokens, temperature, comp_lambda, boundary_policy). Every arm must be tuned on validation with the same declared grid before the test read; the cosine threshold arm is not LM-trained (only comp_reg trains the scalar offset), so csa_dynamic_task is the task-learned policy arm and must be reported separately.

test_slice.loader: a disjoint corpus or a row-offset slice never read by v5

primary_comparisons.name: dynamic-vs-fixed: csa_dynamic_rope - csa_fixed_rope @ L4096
primary_comparisons.hypothesis_direction: non-directional: does the cosine-boundary dynamic arm beat the fixed 4-token block arm at the same read budget?

primary_comparisons.name: task-vs-cosine: csa_dynamic_task - csa_dynamic_rope @ L4096
primary_comparisons.hypothesis_direction: negative would show the LM-trained boundary policy beats the cosine heuristic

primary_comparisons.name: hca-vs-csa: hybrid_dynamic_rope - csa_dynamic_rope @ L4096
primary_comparisons.hypothesis_direction: non-directional HCA readout; HCA reads every closed block, so this is not read-budget matched

primary_comparisons.name: sink-matched dense vs dynamic: full_rope_sink - csa_dynamic_rope @ L4096
primary_comparisons.hypothesis_direction: system-level dynamic-vs-dense readout with the sink matched

statistics.test: exact two-sided sign-flip over paired per-seed deltas
statistics.decision_rule: DRAFT: not active. Once frozen, CONFIRMED requires p_holm<0.05, direction match, parameter match, full coverage and the pre-test power gate on a disjoint test source.

boundary_f1.note: secondary segmentation endpoint; needs the same boundary labels and tolerance as v10's boundary_alignment; never folded into the PPL Holm family

scope.not_covered: fixed-chunk selection/sink claims are covered by confirmation_frozen.json, not here
scope.required_for: a disjoint test source, a new freeze, a pre-test power simulation and the same strict admission/freeze-lock machinery

precondition.test_source: FineWeb-Edu (preferred) or a disjoint WikiText-103 document split
precondition.must_not_reuse: results_lm_test rows 0-47 already reserved for the fixed v5 study
precondition.why: a second confirmation on the same test rows is not independent; the first read fixes the slice and the freeze lock only protects that manifest
